name: scribbled
description: The pen never lifted: form is built out of scribbled mass, so the darks are back-and-forth strokes and the edges overshoot the shape.

prompt.default: scribbled drawing: form built from overlapping back-and-forth pen strokes rather than tone, stroke ends overshooting the contour, denser scribble where it is dark
prompt.flux: a scribbled drawing, mass built from overlapping back-and-forth pen strokes instead of shading, the strokes overshooting the contour at the edges, scribble packed tighter in the shadows
prompt.sdxl: scribble drawing, overlapping pen strokes, rough edges, no shading gradient, energetic marks, monochrome
